about: Labeled claim pairs for wazoobench#10. merge=true: one rule in two phrasings. kind=hard-negative: same library/topic, different rule (the over-merge risk for embeddings). source=corpus: texts quoted from FINDINGS.md or the dream tests; source=authored: hand-written in the corpus claim style.
